702.noahz: Dorian Noahz introduced himself as a tailor from Northwick. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice. Orders assigned Dorian Noahz to work as a machine gunner. The first lesson began with what not to touch.

Dorian Noahz won a pocket watch that does not work at cards from a lance corporal in S-F21. The lance corporal wants a rematch. A letter from home reached Dorian Noahz before dusk. Dorian Noahz read it twice and slept a little easier. Hill 304 is lost. Dorian Noahz heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

A bullet went through Dorian Noahz's sleeve at S-F21 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Dorian Robertoneill of the Hegemony (@robertoneill2008). A letter from home reached Dorian Noahz before dusk. Dorian Noahz read it twice and slept a little easier.
Dorian Noahz no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
The gun at S-F21 jammed twice and fired once. Once was enough: Silas Kjellx, gravely wounded.

Rematch. Dorian Noahz lost everything he won, plus a pressed cornflower. The whole dugout watched. A letter from home reached Dorian Noahz before dusk. Dorian Noahz read it twice and slept a little easier.

Dorian Noahz did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Dorian Noahz fired back. Matthias "Brick" Fish was grazed. After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Dorian Noahz helped stack spare sandbags at S-F21. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

The section held a competition for the worst joke. Dorian Noahz won before reaching the end of his entry. A letter from home reached Dorian Noahz before dusk. Dorian Noahz read it twice and slept a little easier. Dorian Noahz got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 343. The men who came later will ask about it. After what happened at Grey Mill, Dorian Noahz asked to serve as a sniper. Nobody argued. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Dorian Noahz wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

A dummy head on a stick drew the enemy's eye at S-F21. Dorian Noahz saw where the answering shot came from and fired back. Cyril Raphixdx was gravely wounded. A letter from home reached Dorian Noahz before dusk. Dorian Noahz read it twice and slept a little easier.

Casimir "Owl" Mas saved the last of the sugar for Dorian Noahz's birthday. Nobody knows if it really was Dorian's birthday. It was a good day anyway. A letter from home reached Dorian Noahz before dusk. Dorian Noahz read it twice and slept a little easier.

Dorian Noahz fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Quentin Dorufotograf, now grazed. A letter from home reached Dorian Noahz before dusk. Dorian Noahz read it twice and slept a little easier.
At S-F21 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Dorian Noahz won the bet. Karel "Mud" Pasta was grazed.
The men have learned that Dorian Noahz sleeps with his boots on. Tonight it made them laugh, which was worth a great deal.
_jakub_gazda_: The new lieutenant gave his name as Viktor Gazda. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.

On a quiet night Viktor Gazda (Hegemony) and Jonas "Brick" Chieftain (Concord) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Viktor Gazda shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

A grenade burst short of the parapet at T-F21. Viktor Gazda took a splinter in the hand and was bandaged where he stood. A letter from home reached Viktor Gazda before dusk. Viktor Gazda read it twice and slept a little easier.
The medic looked at Viktor Gazda's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to T-F21. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet found Viktor Gazda at T-F21, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. A letter from home reached Viktor Gazda before dusk. Viktor Gazda read it twice and slept a little easier.

The wound looked small. It was not. Viktor Gazda was carried back with a fever and a hand that would not stop shaking. An orderly waved the bearers in: one bed, cleared and scrubbed. Viktor Gazda was lifted onto it in the hospital dugout.
Viktor Gazda ate a whole bowl of soup today. The surgeon says that is better than any medicine. A letter for Viktor Gazda came with a pressed flower inside. Viktor Gazda showed the flower to nobody.
anderred4477: Cyril "Crow" Anderred came up the line with a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Cyril "Crow" Anderred wrote to a sweetheart who has stopped writing that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Cyril "Crow" Anderred took a wrong turn at two identical trench junctions. He decided the route needed names that could be remembered under pressure.
A new trench junction cost Cyril "Crow" Anderred ten minutes. On the way back, he marked the right turn with a broken spoon.
Cyril "Crow" Anderred offered to read the newspaper aloud. The audience asked for the advertisements first, then the racing results, and the war last.
Cyril "Crow" Anderred marked the first junction with a spoon and the second with a boot sole. Other runners have begun using the names in their directions.
Someone removed the spoon from Cyril "Crow" Anderred's junction to eat supper. He retrieved it and nailed it above comfortable reaching height.
bohdanleki: Henrik Bohdanleki left a teacher who said he would amount to nothing behind in Northwick and came up the line with his mother's thimble. The men noticed at once that he reads the same book over and over.
Henrik Bohdanleki was hit in the foot through his boot at V-F18. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Edmund Jackson of the Concord (@robbie_jackson420).
Henrik Bohdanleki spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice.
codibandz456: Albin Codibandz came from Saint-Lune, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.

Albin Codibandz was hit through the stomach at V-F20. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Shot by Hugo Gdaydane of the Concord (@gdaydane). Albin Codibandz stood up to fix a loose sandbag at V-F20. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Hugo Gdaydane of the Concord (@gdaydane).

Benedikt "Tin" Codibandz asked about Albin Codibandz on arriving at V-F20. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another. Now serving as a sniper, Benedikt "Tin" Codibandz discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job.

An empty jam tin became Benedikt "Tin" Codibandz's cup. The first drink still tasted of strawberries. He took small sips. A letter for Benedikt "Tin" Codibandz came with a pressed flower inside. Benedikt "Tin" Codibandz showed the flower to nobody.
daremiamor: Benedikt Daremiamor told the sergeant he was a blacksmith. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.

Benedikt Daremiamor found water collecting beneath the gun's cover. He sketched a small shelter and took the drawing to the stores. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Benedikt Daremiamor stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Dorian Shpkunky saw Benedikt Daremiamor freeze up on the fire step at Blackwater Canal. Dorian said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough. A letter from home reached Benedikt Daremiamor before dusk. Benedikt Daremiamor read it twice and slept a little easier. Orders assigned Benedikt Daremiamor to work as a sniper. The first lesson began with what not to touch.

Benedikt Daremiamor made a list of things to buy on leave. It started with socks and ended with a meal nobody could call a ration. A letter from home reached Benedikt Daremiamor before dusk. Benedikt Daremiamor read it twice and slept a little easier.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet found Benedikt Daremiamor at P-F3, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. A letter from home reached Benedikt Daremiamor before dusk. Benedikt Daremiamor read it twice and slept a little easier.
The medics had to choose who got the last bed. They did not choose Benedikt Daremiamor. He died on the stretcher before morning.
Gideon "Button" Daremiamor came to the front because his uncle Benedikt Daremiamor never came home. He carries a stub of a pencil.

Gideon "Button" Daremiamor was on watch at P-F3 when the night raid hit. The men found Gideon "Button" Daremiamor at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Viktor Thejazzbutch of the Hegemony (@thejazzbutcher).
Benedikt Daremiamor asked about Gideon "Button" Daremiamor on arriving at P-F3. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
dav.cl_: The sergeant gave Roland Dav a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 11 or any other. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Roland Dav stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Roland Dav lent Viktor K a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'.
Fog hid the far end of N-F16. Roland Dav kept counting the turns so as not to walk past the dugout.
The enemy tried to rush a supply sled across the open ground. Roland Dav was faster. Clement "Hollow" Claymcc was badly wounded.
Two men fed the belt while Roland Dav held the gun steady on the enemy parapet. When they stopped, Dorian "Mud" Parrinello was grazed.
Roland Dav had kept the gun aimed at the enemy supply path for days. Tonight the supply party came, and Hugo Rambo was grazed.
halil.ibrahim.timucin: Cyril "Rabbit" Timucin walked into T-F5 on Day 10 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.

Cyril "Rabbit" Timucin had marked the corner of the enemy trench with two stakes in daylight. At night the gun fired between the stakes, blind. Nils "Mud" Ohcuri was grazed. Cyril "Rabbit" Timucin walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Cyril "Rabbit" Timucin fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Nils "Mud" Ohcuri, badly wounded. Nobody nearby said anything.
Cyril "Rabbit" Timucin found a shirt button in the bread. He ate around it and kept the button. Both were useful.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Cyril "Rabbit" Timucin tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at T-F5 is up. Cyril "Rabbit" Timucin had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Gideon Northerncoun was badly wounded.
Cyril "Rabbit" Timucin fired a burst, moved the gun ten yards, and fired again before the enemy could reply. Matthias Benmarine was grazed.

The Concord sentry, Clement William, shouted once. Cyril "Rabbit" Timucin silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@william_fg9) In the dark of the Concord trench Cyril "Rabbit" Timucin hit Teodor "Rabbit" Wendigoarms with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@wendigoarms)
jake_gillespy: Nobody saw Viktor Gillespy arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in N-F3, and a quiet sapper under it.
The bread was divided with a ruler. Viktor Gillespy received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler.
johnrant21: Nobody asked Clement "Lucky" Johnrant why he came. Nobody in S-F16 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.

A bucket appeared above the Concord parapet at the Drowned Farm. Isidor Lowelleast fired; Clement "Lucky" Johnrant pulled the bucket down. A sign later appeared: 'Water costs enough already.' Clement "Lucky" Johnrant walked the captured trenches of Verdel Ridge and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Clement "Lucky" Johnrant fired at a movement across the wire at S-F16. The man went down: Rafael "Owl" Zelenszki, grazed.
Clement "Lucky" Johnrant began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else.

A bullet found Clement "Lucky" Johnrant at S-F16, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Dietrich Thky of the Hegemony (@haydnburrell_9thky). The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Hill 304. Clement "Lucky" Johnrant read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
A bed came free in the hospital dugout, and Clement "Lucky" Johnrant was carried in at last.
The man in the next bed snored all day. Clement "Lucky" Johnrant did not mind. It meant someone was still breathing.
Declared fit, Clement "Lucky" Johnrant reported back to S-F16. The familiar smell reached him before the familiar voices.
Clement "Lucky" Johnrant has fired hundreds of rounds into the dark. Today one of them found someone: Otto Elitecelebs, grazed.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Clement "Lucky" Johnrant kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Word of Clement "Lucky" Johnrant's blanket spread. A strip of lining and a square from an old scarf arrived without explanation. Clement "Lucky" Johnrant got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 123. The men who came later will ask about it. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Clement "Lucky" Johnrant wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Clement "Lucky" Johnrant's ear at S-F16 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Emil "Lucky" Jarvisben of the Hegemony (@jarvisben).
The medics cleaned Clement "Lucky" Johnrant's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-F16.
Clement "Lucky" Johnrant spent the night in no man's land with pliers and a roll of wire. Every flare meant lying flat in the mud. The gap at S-F16 is closed now.
Clement "Lucky" Johnrant did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Clement "Lucky" Johnrant fired back. Severin Stry was grazed.
Clement "Lucky" Johnrant finished the blanket using six kinds of cloth. The men can identify most of the donors by the patches alone.
jordanillman: Zeno Jordanillman unpacked a tin whistle at R-S17. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.

Zeno Jordanillman fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Casimir Nile, grazed. A round came through the loophole Zeno Jordanillman was watching at R-S17 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Walter Snixx of the Concord (@snixx_93). Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Zeno Jordanillman watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work. Mail came up the line with a letter for Zeno Jordanillman. Zeno Jordanillman read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

No bed, no surgeon, just a medic with a kit and a lot of patience. Zeno Jordanillman recovered anyway and is back at R-S17. Mail came up the line with a letter for Zeno Jordanillman. Zeno Jordanillman read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Zeno Jordanillman got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 627. The men who came later will ask about it. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Zeno Jordanillman shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Zeno Jordanillman drew a line on the bench to settle an argument about space. Everyone obeyed it until the broadest man returned from duty. Mail came up the line with a letter for Zeno Jordanillman. Zeno Jordanillman read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

In the fog a figure walked along the parapet of R-S17. When Zeno Jordanillman challenged it, there was nobody there. Mail came up the line with a letter for Zeno Jordanillman. Zeno Jordanillman read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Face blackened with soot, Zeno Jordanillman spent the night in a shell hole out in front of the wire. At first light Otto "Smokes" Noah was grazed.

A beetle crawled across Zeno Jordanillman's sleeve during the long wait. He could do nothing about it without giving away the position. Mail came up the line with a letter for Zeno Jordanillman. Zeno Jordanillman read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Zeno Jordanillman lost a boot in the trench. Leopold Hanginbang found it, stuffed it with dry socks, and gave it back without a word. Zeno Jordanillman read the letter, folded it, unfolded it, and read it again. The sentry pretended not to see.
lettersabcd: Ivo "Ghost" Lettersabcd told the sergeant he was a dance-hall violinist. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed more rain, and put him on sentry.
First Wave. Ivo "Ghost" Lettersabcd signed when the posters were still wet. He keeps the ribbon wrapped in oilcloth with a frozen apple.
Victory at Verdel Ridge. Ivo "Ghost" Lettersabcd let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
The party came back from Sorrow Copse by different routes. By dawn, everyone had been accounted for except Ivo "Ghost" Lettersabcd.
The missing report was still on the desk when Ivo "Ghost" Lettersabcd walked in. The clerk crossed it out hard enough to tear the paper.

Ivo "Ghost" Lettersabcd saw Edmund Callmequeeno freeze up on the fire step at Hill 304. Ghost said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough. The Hegemony hold Hill 304 now, and they can see straight into R-F10. Ivo "Ghost" Lettersabcd has learned to walk bent double.
The listening post reported scraping beyond the wire. Ivo "Ghost" Lettersabcd waited through an hour of it before a loose stake was found.

A bucket appeared above the Concord parapet at the Hanging Bridge. Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal fired. Ivo "Ghost" Lettersabcd pulled the bucket down. Later a sign went up: 'Water costs enough already.'

A bullet hit Ivo "Ghost" Lettersabcd in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at R-F10. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Dorian Austintress of the Hegemony (@austintress). Ivo "Ghost" Lettersabcd stood up to fix a loose sandbag at R-F10. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Dorian Austintress of the Hegemony (@austintress).

A letter came with Yann "Lucky" Lettersabcd: "I am Ivo "Ghost" Lettersabcd's uncle. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes. As one of the first hundred volunteers, Yann "Lucky" Lettersabcd received the First Wave ribbon. A neighbour lent the needle and supervised every stitch.
The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Yann "Lucky" Lettersabcd asked if second helpings depended on the answer.
The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Yann "Lucky" Lettersabcd looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Yann "Lucky" Lettersabcd lost at cards to the corporal and now owes him a week of tobacco and one favour, unspecified. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Yann "Lucky" Lettersabcd stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Zeno Retarded (Hegemony) and Yann "Lucky" Lettersabcd (Concord) watched each other through the same loophole at Saint-Ash crossroads for an hour. Neither fired. Neither will explain why.
Karel Pavla fell asleep on watch. Yann "Lucky" Lettersabcd took over without waking Karel, and told the sergeant nothing.
Yann "Lucky" Lettersabcd put a folded ration label under a short table leg. Supper stopped sliding toward the corporal.

Yann "Lucky" Lettersabcd (Concord) and Jakub "Spark" Reikland (Hegemony) ended up in the same shell hole at Saint-Ash crossroads. They stared at each other. Then each crawled home, and neither has told anyone.

The Hegemony raiders came over at R-F10 in the middle of the night. Yann "Lucky" Lettersabcd met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Konrad Sebs of the Hegemony (@_sebs.c_).
Jakub "Parson" Lettersabcd joined R-F10 under the shadow of Yann "Lucky" Lettersabcd's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
levitobambito: Nobody saw Teodor "Spark" Levitobambit arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in R-C12, and a quiet sniper under it.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In R-C12, Teodor "Spark" Levitobambit listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Two shots, one miss. The second found Clement "Saint" Jozsef, gravely wounded. Teodor "Spark" Levitobambit cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Teodor "Spark" Levitobambit answered to number 674. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Teodor "Spark" Levitobambit looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Teodor "Spark" Levitobambit of the Concord and Gideon "Doc" Midnight of the Hegemony have been shooting at the same tin can on the wire at the Drowned Farm for a week. Both trenches keep score.
Teodor "Spark" Levitobambit had marked the enemy's path to the latrine on a scrap of paper. Today it paid off: Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen, grazed.
At Saint-Ash crossroads, Teodor "Spark" Levitobambit of the Concord and Henrik "Brick" Sunley of the Hegemony traded insults across the wire for an hour. By the end they were trading recipes.

The last of the jam was shared by passing the tin around. Teodor "Spark" Levitobambit approved the method. A letter from home reached Teodor "Spark" Levitobambit before dusk. Teodor "Spark" Levitobambit read it twice and slept a little easier.
Teodor "Spark" Levitobambit offered to read the newspaper aloud. The audience asked for the advertisements first, then the racing results, and the war last.
lynxxactual: After 9 days of war, S-R8 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Bastian Lynxxactual.

The flare went up just as Bastian Lynxxactual reached the Hegemony parapet. Bastian Lynxxactual jumped down first. Casimir Toro was the man waiting there, and Casimir Toro fell. (@fidel_del_toro) Bastian Lynxxactual was on watch at S-R8 when the night raid hit. The men found Bastian Lynxxactual at dawn by the dugout door.
Jonas Lynxxactual took the same post at S-R8 where Bastian Lynxxactual stood. He found his older brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.

Jonas Lynxxactual was hit in the foot through his boot at S-R8. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Wendel Gers of the Hegemony (@j0seph_r0gers). A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Jonas Lynxxactual is number 832. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached S-R8 with the rations. Jonas Lynxxactual ate while listening to the revised orders.
The medics called Jonas Lynxxactual 'the corridor man', because he lay there so long. Today the corridor is empty. Jonas Lynxxactual is back on the line.
Jonas Lynxxactual and Matthias "Shadow" Deakins tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco.

During a lull at the Sunken Road, Jonas Lynxxactual called across from the Concord line. Jakub "Lucky" Sprite answered from the Hegemony side with a perfect imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet.
Jonas Lynxxactual hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back.
Jonas Lynxxactual tried to sketch a horse from memory. The dugout agreed it was a very good dog.
markus__bucko: By the time Ivo "Shadow" Bucko reached R-C11, the war was 9 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Ivo "Shadow" Bucko watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Ivo "Shadow" Bucko offered a length of string for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Ivo "Shadow" Bucko is number 884. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Ivo "Shadow" Bucko helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Ivo "Shadow" Bucko tried to sketch a horse from memory. The dugout agreed it was a very good dog.
Ivo "Shadow" Bucko borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing.
The whole squad at R-C11 fired five rounds rapid. The squad agrees it was Ivo "Shadow" Bucko's bullet that found Edmund "Button" Hemana, grazed.
Ivo "Shadow" Bucko did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Ivo "Shadow" Bucko fired back. Casimir Eight was badly wounded.
An enemy patrol scattered in front of R-C11. Ivo "Shadow" Bucko fired at the last man to run. Bastian "Mud" Decybecy was grazed.
mecitttk: Dorian "Hollow" Mecitttk took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.

Dorian "Hollow" Mecitttk ended a letter with 'nothing to report', then added half a page about the missing soap. A letter from home found Dorian "Hollow" Mecitttk before the night shift. Dorian "Hollow" Mecitttk folded it small and kept it close.

Dorian "Hollow" Mecitttk's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket. A letter from home found Dorian "Hollow" Mecitttk before the night shift. Dorian "Hollow" Mecitttk folded it small and kept it close.

Dorian "Hollow" Mecitttk was on the dawn watch at V-F10 when the Concord raiders came. A club, a shout, and Dorian "Hollow" Mecitttk was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Casimir Lilly of the Concord (@_bell_lilly_). The letter for Dorian "Hollow" Mecitttk smelled faintly of soap. Dorian "Hollow" Mecitttk held it close for a long time before opening it.
murilmoore.06: Casimir "Rabbit" Murilmoore arrived on Day 6 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
A letter reached Casimir "Rabbit" Murilmoore from Dunmarrow. The streets there still have names. He read them out loud, one by one.
Casimir "Rabbit" Murilmoore bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage.

Casimir "Rabbit" Murilmoore drew the street leading to Dunmarrow. There was no room left for the last house, so he turned the page over. Casimir "Rabbit" Murilmoore's transfer to the role of sapper was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.

Casimir "Rabbit" Murilmoore and Roland Theelliottma compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house. Mail came up the line with a letter for Casimir "Rabbit" Murilmoore. Casimir "Rabbit" Murilmoore read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Casimir "Rabbit" Murilmoore threw a bomb into a Concord dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Severin Martinsatali was down and screaming for a medic. (@martinsatalik) The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Casimir "Rabbit" Murilmoore did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again. Mail came up the line with a letter for Casimir "Rabbit" Murilmoore. Casimir "Rabbit" Murilmoore read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Casimir "Rabbit" Murilmoore was sent to examine a pump that worked only when struck. He asked the men to stop striking it long enough to listen. Mail came up the line with a letter for Casimir "Rabbit" Murilmoore. Casimir "Rabbit" Murilmoore read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Casimir "Rabbit" Murilmoore answered to number 390. Grey Mill has been won. Casimir "Rabbit" Murilmoore listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

The pump's fault proved to be a worn fitting. Casimir "Rabbit" Murilmoore made a replacement from scrap while the men returned to bailing by hand. Mail came up the line with a letter for Casimir "Rabbit" Murilmoore. Casimir "Rabbit" Murilmoore read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The men have learned that Casimir "Rabbit" Murilmoore reads the same book over and over. Tonight it made them laugh, which was worth a great deal. Mail came up the line with a letter for Casimir "Rabbit" Murilmoore. Casimir "Rabbit" Murilmoore read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Casimir "Rabbit" Murilmoore had just lit a cigarette at S-S8 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Mail came up the line with a letter for Casimir "Rabbit" Murilmoore. Casimir "Rabbit" Murilmoore read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Fever took hold of Casimir "Rabbit" Murilmoore overnight. The medics changed the dressing twice and then called for the bearers. Mail came up the line with a letter for Casimir "Rabbit" Murilmoore. Casimir "Rabbit" Murilmoore read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Casimir "Rabbit" Murilmoore asked the bearers for water and then for his mother. He died before either came.

The House of Murilmoore sent Gustav Murilmoore after Casimir "Rabbit" Murilmoore. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks. After what happened at the Sunken Road, Gustav Murilmoore asked to serve as a machine gunner. Nobody argued.
omombintaro: Ivo Omombintaro arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a pocket Bible with a hole in it and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.

Ivo Omombintaro was hit in the forearm at V-F17. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Albin "Ash" Thehassand of the Concord (@thehassand).

Ivo Omombintaro spent the day with his arm in a sling, writing letters for men who cannot write. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ivo Omombintaro. Ivo Omombintaro read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Ivo Omombintaro sat out the day with a bandaged arm, cleaning every rifle within reach. It was the only job the medic would allow.
rottenr0be: "You're late," said the corporal when Norbert Rottenr arrived on Day 9. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into S-C5. Norbert Rottenr has learned to walk bent double. A letter from home found Norbert Rottenr before the night shift. Norbert Rottenr folded it small and kept it close.

Norbert Rottenr had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Felix Austin crossed it, Norbert Rottenr fired. Felix Austin was grazed. A letter from home found Norbert Rottenr before the night shift. Norbert Rottenr folded it small and kept it close. The clerk counted the names twice. Norbert Rottenr is number 733 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In S-C5, Norbert Rottenr listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

A new recruit would not eat with the others. Norbert Rottenr left a place at the end of the bench and said nothing about it. A letter from home found Norbert Rottenr before the night shift. Norbert Rottenr folded it small and kept it close.
Dawn watch. Norbert Rottenr put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Dorian "Mole" Guapoo, grazed.

The sergeant at S-C5 called out a range and a spot. Norbert Rottenr was the only one who hit it. Albin Prokes was grazed. Norbert Rottenr lay buried at S-C5 for long minutes before anyone could dig him out. Now every minute counts. Norbert Rottenr was killed outright by a direct hit at S-C5. The men dug for an hour and found only his identity disc.

Teodor Rottenr had heard about Norbert Rottenr's courage. At S-C5, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting. Teodor Rottenr's transfer to the role of machine gunner was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.

The machine gun jammed at the worst moment. Teodor Rottenr cleared it with a bent nail and words the chaplain pretended not to hear. A letter from home found Teodor Rottenr before the night shift. Teodor Rottenr folded it small and kept it close.

Teodor Rottenr was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at S-C5. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Arno "Tin" Ryukov of the Hegemony (@ryukov46). Teodor Rottenr had kept the gun aimed at the enemy supply path for days. Tonight the supply party came, and Dorian "Mole" Guapoo was badly wounded. The letter for Teodor Rottenr had a few coins taped inside. They would buy almost nothing here, but Teodor Rottenr kept them.
searcher.of.the.light: Otto "Parson" Light joined the replacements on Day 9. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.

A bullet went through Otto "Parson" Light's upper arm at T-F13 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Bastian Tartochuk of the Concord (@tartochuk). Otto "Parson" Light was killed at T-F13 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Bastian Tartochuk of the Concord (@tartochuk).
Roland Light put a pocket Bible with a hole in it beside the bunk. Someone who had known Otto "Parson" Light helped clear the shelf without saying why.

Roland Light let three easy targets go by. The fourth was the one worth the risk. Teodor Mma was badly wounded. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Roland Light did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
A round went through Roland Light's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Jonas "Spark" Jug of the Concord (@wicker_jug).
The medic looked at Roland Light's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to T-F13. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
The corporal found out Roland Light used to be a postman. Roland Light has been doing two jobs ever since.
Roland Light took stock of his pockets: string, crumbs, a pencil and no sign of the button he was looking for.
Roland Light raised his head for a heartbeat too long at T-F13. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Henrik "Parson" Xdissonvncex of the Concord (@xdissonvncex).
the_john_military: Emil Military came from Halden, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.

The patrol came back one man at a time. Emil Military held the gap open and counted until the corporal said that was everyone. A letter from home reached Emil Military before dusk. Emil Military read it twice and slept a little easier.

Wiring party. Emil Military held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at S-F3, and everyone came back. A letter from home reached Emil Military before dusk. Emil Military read it twice and slept a little easier. Hill 304 is in Hegemony hands. Emil Military stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

The corporal found out Emil Military used to be a baker. Emil Military has been doing two jobs ever since. A letter from home reached Emil Military before dusk. Emil Military read it twice and slept a little easier.

Emil Military fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Jakub Mccooper, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. A letter from home reached Emil Military before dusk. Emil Military read it twice and slept a little easier.

A bullet found Emil Military at S-F3, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Oskar Perry of the Hegemony (@bo.perry._). Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Oskar Perry stood up to sing louder, and Emil Military fired. Oskar Perry was badly wounded. The singing stopped.

No bed for Emil Military yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up. A letter from home reached Emil Military before dusk. Emil Military read it twice and slept a little easier.

The medics would not give up on Emil Military. On a stretcher in the open, between salvos, they kept him alive and then kept him whole. He returned to S-F3 today. After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Emil Military helped stack spare sandbags at S-F3. Nobody asked when they would be needed. A letter from home reached Emil Military before dusk. Emil Military read it twice and slept a little easier.

Emil Military fixed the strap on Ivo Camper's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut. A letter from home reached Emil Military before dusk. Emil Military read it twice and slept a little easier. The clerk counted the names twice. Emil Military is number 297 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Emil Military kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Roland "Ash" Hud of the Hegemony lost a harmonica in no man's land at the Ossuary Wood. Emil Military of the Concord found it and has been learning the enemy's songs on it. A letter from home reached Emil Military before dusk. Emil Military read it twice and slept a little easier.
A bullet hit the sandbag beside Emil Military. He ducked, and noticed his hands were shaking. He kept working anyway.

Emil Military dreamt about missing a train. Waking up here felt like a harsh punishment for it. A letter from home reached Emil Military before dusk. Emil Military read it twice and slept a little easier.

A loose thread in Emil Military's blanket turned out to be very long. By the time he stopped pulling, there was a hole to explain. A letter from home reached Emil Military before dusk. Emil Military read it twice and slept a little easier.

Emil Military fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Viktor Thervvival was grazed. Emil Military ate breakfast without a word. At S-F3 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Emil Military won the bet. Jakub Mccooper was gravely wounded. The letter for Emil Military was mostly about the weather at home. Emil Military read that part twice too.
thebutcher5655: Benedikt "Saint" Thebutcher arrived on Day 5 as a replacement. The men in R-S9 had been fighting for 4 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.

A report called the trench satisfactory. Benedikt "Saint" Thebutcher invited the author to spend a night in it before signing. Victory at Hill 304. Benedikt "Saint" Thebutcher let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
A borrowed pencil wore down while Benedikt "Saint" Thebutcher was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first.
Benedikt "Saint" Thebutcher of the Hegemony and Nils Zczc of the Concord watched a broken branch near Hill 304 all morning. Neither could risk assuming it was only a branch.
Benedikt "Saint" Thebutcher lost at cards to the corporal and now owes him a week of tobacco and one favour, unspecified.
Oskar Urfavv (Concord) and Benedikt "Saint" Thebutcher (Hegemony) watched each other through the same loophole at the Brickworks for an hour. Neither fired. Neither will explain why.
The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Benedikt "Saint" Thebutcher did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

Benedikt "Saint" Thebutcher wrote a song about Calvary Farm. Ivo Felixwallner wrote a second verse. The squad has banned the third. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Benedikt "Saint" Thebutcher answered to number 362. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Benedikt "Saint" Thebutcher shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Benedikt "Saint" Thebutcher taught Jakub "Spark" Reikland three words in the language of home. Spark uses all three at the wrong moment, every day.
Benedikt "Saint" Thebutcher saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards.
A loose thread in Benedikt "Saint" Thebutcher's blanket turned out to be very long. By the time he stopped pulling, there was a hole to explain.
Benedikt "Saint" Thebutcher and Edmund "Shadow" Idkdunnoman made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it.
Benedikt "Saint" Thebutcher caught a falling mug with his boot. Nobody could say if it was skill or luck, and he did not say either.
thewilliampoole: "You're late," said the corporal when Wendel Thewilliampo arrived on Day 8. "Everyone's late. Get a spade." Wendel Thewilliampo transferred to the runners. The men in S-S13 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away.

A new trench junction cost Wendel Thewilliampo ten minutes. On the way back, he marked the right turn with a broken spoon. A letter from home found Wendel Thewilliampo before the night shift. Wendel Thewilliampo folded it small and kept it close.

The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In S-S13, Wendel Thewilliampo listened to three explanations and trusted none of them. A letter from home found Wendel Thewilliampo before the night shift. Wendel Thewilliampo folded it small and kept it close.

A letter reached Wendel Thewilliampo from Stoneyford. The streets there still have names. He read them out loud, one by one. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Wendel Thewilliampo is number 512. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Wendel Thewilliampo wrote to a younger sister who sends drawings that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Arno Ricks carried Wendel Thewilliampo's rifle all the way up to the Chalk Pits after Wendel twisted an ankle. Neither has said thank you. Neither needs to.

Wendel Thewilliampo found a flower growing out of a sandbag. He did not tell anyone. He checks on it every morning. A letter from home found Wendel Thewilliampo before the night shift. Wendel Thewilliampo folded it small and kept it close.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Wendel Thewilliampo was hit twice at S-S13, once in the leg and once in the side. The second wound is the bad one. Wendel Thewilliampo finally has a bed in the hospital dugout. A real blanket, a lamp, and a surgeon who has not slept. A letter from home found Wendel Thewilliampo before the night shift. Wendel Thewilliampo folded it small and kept it close.

Wendel Thewilliampo recognized the orderly today and said the orderly's name out loud. The surgeon says he will pull through. A letter from home found Wendel Thewilliampo before the night shift. Wendel Thewilliampo folded it small and kept it close.

A medic stopped by Wendel Thewilliampo's stretcher every few hours for a week. Today the medic found it empty. Wendel Thewilliampo had gone back to S-S13. The letter for Wendel Thewilliampo smelled faintly of soap. Wendel Thewilliampo held it close for a long time before opening it. Wendel Thewilliampo reported for duty as a sniper. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.
tombstoneactual228: After 9 days of war, Q-F11 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Albin "Owl" Tombstoneact.
The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Albin "Owl" Tombstoneact read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

The shelling stopped while Albin "Owl" Tombstoneact was counting the seconds between hits. He kept counting anyway, and waited a long time before moving. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into Q-F11. Albin "Owl" Tombstoneact has learned to walk bent double.
Albin "Owl" Tombstoneact sharpened a pencil carefully and then could not think what to write. He put the date at the top anyway.
Albin "Owl" Tombstoneact wrote a song about Calvary Farm. Emil Sup wrote a second verse. The squad has banned the third.
Part of the parapet collapsed near Albin "Owl" Tombstoneact. Repairs started as soon as the dust settled, with one man on watch while the rest worked.
Dorian "Ash" Martin drew a map of Albin "Owl" Tombstoneact's hometown from Owl's stories. Owl says it is wrong in every detail, and carries it everywhere.

A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at Q-F11. Albin "Owl" Tombstoneact was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Ulrich Ljuliolemosl of the Hegemony (@ljuliolemosl).
The House of Tombstoneact sent Ulrich Tombstoneact after Albin "Owl" Tombstoneact. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
virajvirxgill13: Nobody saw Jakub Virajvirxgil arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in R-F16, and a quiet machine gunner under it.
Jakub Virajvirxgil and Albin Chloe shared the last tin of bully beef in the bay, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair.

Lightning lit the Chalk Pits and Jakub Virajvirxgil saw the enemy wire, the enemy trench, and a man in it looking straight back. News of the loss of Verdel Ridge reached R-F16 with the rations. Jakub Virajvirxgil ate while listening to the revised orders.
The guns found R-F16. Jakub Virajvirxgil was dug out of a collapsed dugout with both legs pinned and carried back on a groundsheet.
Jakub Virajvirxgil lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk.

There was never a bed for Jakub Virajvirxgil, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to R-F16 on his own feet. The Hegemony flag went up over Hill 304. Jakub Virajvirxgil did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Jakub Virajvirxgil had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Wendel "Mole" Kelvincornbr crossed it, Jakub Virajvirxgil fired. Wendel "Mole" Kelvincornbr was grazed.
Jakub Virajvirxgil fired at a movement across the wire at R-F16. The man went down: Jonas Utku, grazed.

Two shots, one miss. The second found Oskar "Smokes" Guyy, badly wounded. Jakub Virajvirxgil cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not. Jakub Virajvirxgil had just lit a cigarette at R-F16 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Edmund "Whistle" Es of the Concord (@es31230).
Jakub Virajvirxgil returned to R-F16 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.

Nobody heard the Concord raiders cut the wire. Jakub Virajvirxgil only heard boots on the duckboards at R-F16, then nothing but pain. Raider: Walter "Ghost" Wizzerd of the Concord (@flying_wizzerd). News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Jakub Virajvirxgil during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

A bullet found Jakub Virajvirxgil at R-F16, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Arno "Parson" Theverb of the Concord (@theverb95). The clerk counted the names twice. Jakub Virajvirxgil is number 109 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Jakub Virajvirxgil watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Jakub Virajvirxgil finally has a bed in the hospital dugout. A real blanket, a lamp, and a surgeon who has not slept.
Jakub Virajvirxgil slept most of the day. When he woke, someone had left a cup of tea on the crate beside the bed.
Jakub Virajvirxgil survived the wound and the waiting. He is back at R-F16, and still will not talk about the nights outside the aid post.
A bullet went through Jakub Virajvirxgil's sleeve at R-F16 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Rafael Official of the Concord (@deutsches_kaiserreich_official).

A round came through the loophole Jakub Virajvirxgil was watching at R-F16 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Rafael Official of the Concord (@deutsches_kaiserreich_official).
